pages.text: A $(item)Car Dealership$()'s owner parks cars within 10 blocks of it to make a lot, prices them on the $(l)Lot$() tab, and sets what it pays for trade-ins. Customers buy from the lot, or sell their own car to the dealership.
Buy on $(l)finance$(): 20% down, then ten daily payments, with 10% interest.

Until a loan's paid off, the car can't be sold or picked up. Miss three payments in a row and it's $(4)repossessed$() to the nearest impound lot. Pay off the loan early from the dealership's Trade in tab.
